Received Payments: Notification when a payment has been made by a tenant.

Property Occupancy & Reports:

Overall Portfolio Occupancy: A consolidated report showing the occupancy status across all properties managed by the property manager.

Property Visit Requests: Alerts when potential tenants schedule a visit to view a property.
Property Financial Performance Reports: Monthly Report showing the cash flow of properties

Direct Messages: Notifications for direct messages from tenants, subcontractors, or system administrators.
Announcements: System-wide announcements or updates.
Feedback & Reviews: Alerts when a tenant leaves feedback or a review after the termination of their lease.

Security & Account:
Login Alerts: Receive a notification for unusual login activities or logins from new devices.
Password Change: Alerts when the account password is changed.
Profile Updates: Notification when any significant changes are made to the profile.

Preference Settings:
Notification Frequency: Options to receive notifications instantly, as a daily digest, or weekly roundup.
Notification Channels: Preferences for how to receive notifications - through email, SMS, in-app, or push notifications.

The property manager will be able to toggle/select each of these settings on or off based on their preference.
